links.outcome: CT-FFR_AI per-vessel diagnostic accuracy versus CCTA across cohorts with different CAD prevalence
links.effect: Accuracy depended on cohort: PACIFIC-1 77% vs 76% (CCTA ≥50%, P=0.689) and 74% (≥70%, P=0.183); real-world 63% vs 52% and 57% (P<0.001, P=0.034).
links.quote: CT-FFRAI may outperform anatomic assessment alone, with diagnostic accuracy depending on the prevalence of obstructive coronary artery disease and the range of stenosis severities among vessels undergoing invasive FFR assessment.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic performance and net reclassification of an AI-based CT-FFR model across different clinical cohorts (study protocol vs real-world cohort) retrospectively without testing deployment practices or safeguards.
